item.title: Release 2026.04.22 (build 5)
item.description:
Summary

  • feat: INCREASED ICON CUTENESS!
  • feat(board): streamline focus mode chrome and card sizing
  • feat(release): canonicalize summary from feed to appcast

Details

  • [Added] feat: INCREASED ICON CUTENESS!
  • [Added] feat(board): streamline focus mode chrome and card sizing
  • [Added] feat(release): canonicalize summary from feed to appcast
  • [Added] feat: replace radial gradient background with Light Background image asset
  • [Added] feat(ui): truncate quest card details at 2 blocks with ellipsis indicator
  • [Added] feat(ui): add status indicator emoji to settings sidebar services
  • [Added] feat(coda): implement Another Day via Deferred Until column
  • [Added] feat(linear): implement Another Day via backlog state
  • [Added] feat(tests): add Another Day test coverage
  • [Added] feat(another-day): implement Another Day for On Deck quests
  • [Added] feat(ui): add SnoozedPillRow between underway and on-deck sections
  • [Added] feat(ui): add Refresh button to toolbar and inline control bar
  • [Added] feat(ui): hide Send Underway button when TRMNL is not configured
  • [Added] feat(search): add case-insensitive debounced title search to On Deck view
  • [Fixed] fix: hide window toolbar in focus mode and document hierarchy guidance
  • [Fixed] fix: keep toolbar and search visible during focus mode
  • [Fixed] fix(things): use schedule command instead of setting schedule date property
  • [Fixed] fix(things): strip time component from tomorrow date in schedule AppleScript
  • [Fixed] fix(linear): remove Another Day support — snoozedUntilAt is not an issue field
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): use .searchable modifier for On Deck toolbar search field
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): show search field in toolbar when inline lane picker is hidden
  • [Internal] chore(release): wire default OpenAI key for note drafting
  • [Internal] refactor: isolate gradient-to-NSImage logic in QuestBoardBackgroundImage
  • [Internal] refactor: render board background gradient into NSImage for compositor blending
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): remove showsInlineLanePicker — toolbar is the only path
  • [Internal] refactor(rename): Defer → Snooze throughout app and tests
  • [Internal] chore(release): v2026.04.17-0317 (build 4)
